The next character to switch in will have their <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> upgraded to an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>.
Each time <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> reaches 90 or an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color>. A maximum of 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Customer Complaint</color> can be held at a time.
en.BanYue_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, when Banyue consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> to unleash an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vidyaraja</color> increases his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
en.BanYue_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_AssaultAid_Light_Desc:
After successfully parrying an enemy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Counter_Desc:
After a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered through <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Overcome Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or after a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered though <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Evade_Taunt_Desc:
Rotate the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} in a half-circle and press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> and quickly execute the required inputs during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color> to then follow up with the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Banyue has more than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, he automatically enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline when using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Enhance_Title: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
After an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline when using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Enhance_Title: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
During an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, quickly input <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_Cancel_Desc:
When Banyue activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> can be interrupted. Each <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>'s effect. Interrupting an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Cancel</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and with <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Cancel</color> is easier to trigger.
en.BanYue_Skill_ExSpecial_Defense_Desc:
While attacking, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Charge_Desc:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue immediately enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_EnterAngry_Desc:
While not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and with at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to nearby enemies, then enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_FinalAttack_Desc:
When Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this move, Banyue exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_FinalAttack_Enhance_:
While Banyue is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and after performing two different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Banyue automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Heavy_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Normal_Light_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Banyue has more than 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, he automatically enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.BanYue_Skill_Rush_Desc:
During a dodge, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or during <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Battle Cry</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Towering Peaks</color> or the 2nd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Majestic Summit</color>.
en.BanYue_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> when parrying an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Immovable Mountain</color>, and recover 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color> upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. When he possesses at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state by using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Immolate</color>. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue can no longer gain <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. After Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, he exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state.
When entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, Banyue gains 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>. If Banyue has <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>, launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, remove all <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color>.
When possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Mountain's Might</color> in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to launch four different <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color> in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, he increases his Sheer Force by <color=#2BAD00>150</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>, and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

en.Burnice_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color> hits an enemy, or when the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is triggered, the move's accumulated <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.
en.Burnice_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_BeHitAid_UpGrade_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When leaping into the air, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> will be triggered. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_01_UpGrade_Desc:

en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:

Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.Burnice_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot

en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Spin continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move that inflicts <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
When the move is activated, it consumes 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>;
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Normal_Enhance_UpGrade_Des:
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> that doesn't cost <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> and deals <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward rush attack with the flamethrower, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>;
Press and hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Burnice_Skill_Special_Title: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
en.Burnice_Skill_UpGrade_02_Desc:
If Burnice has <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> triggered by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color> hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color>, the counter no longer increases. Consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Emberflow</color> clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>480%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>240%</color>/<color=#FF5521>600%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>40%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>60%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>24%</color> of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color> increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>.
en.Burnice_Skill_UpGrade_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Tossing Method
en.Burnice_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state until all <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glorious Inferno</color>, she applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect to the target until she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Nitro-Fuel Cocktail</color> state. When other squad members hit enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> status, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, expending 8 <color=#FFFFFF>Heat</color> to deal <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>175%</color> of Burnice's ATK and accumulate <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Attack</color> DMG.

When Caesar activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dead End</color>, she applies a Debuff effect to enemies within a 7m radius, increasing the damage they take from all squad members by 25% for 30s.
en.Caesar_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a slash that deals <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
After activating the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Stabs at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_Counter_Title: Dodge Counter: Eye For an Eye
en.Caesar_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:40+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*5,1,2}%</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color> without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Parry Counter</color>, with enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an <color=#FFFFFF>Interrupt</color> is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
When the skill is activated through <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, it cannot trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> again.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
en.Caesar_Skill_Normal_Branch_01_Desc:
When there are sufficient <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Consume 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> to toss the shield and attack nearby enemies in all directions, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 slashes ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Caesar_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_Revenge_Desc: When Caesar triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, her impact is increased by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:8+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*1,1,2}</color>% for 3s.
en.Caesar_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During skill activation, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets knocked back. Following that, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> and activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>.
en.Caesar_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color>, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color>.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color>, activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Roaring Thrust</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash</color>
When <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.
en.Caesar_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Thrusts forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill when <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Retaliation</color> is triggered.

en.Cissia_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character or shares the same attribute:
While possessing <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 40%, with Cissia gaining an additional 10%. The effect lasts until 30s after <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is depleted.
en.Cissia_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Leaps forward and performs a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
During this skill, you can quickly chain into <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Bared Fangs</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Venomous Bite</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_Branch_Desc:
With <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto a target, then slams down, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
While locking on, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> and drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to extend the lock-on duration and freely control the landing position.
For every 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> gained, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Using this skill consumes 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Serpentine Shadow</color>.
Upon hitting an enemy, all <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> is consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_CurseBurst_Desc:
Deal <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> to nearby enemies.
Each trigger increases CRIT Rate by 6% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
en.Cissia_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a thunderbolt attack in front, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>, lasting 30s. All squad members' CRIT DMG increases by 5% for the duration.
Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color> a second time will first deactivate the active <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Cold-Blooded</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleash multiple long-range snake bites forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Grants 5 Energy when the move is used.
When activating by holding, consumes additional Energy. For every 20 additional Energy consumed, unleash 1 extra strike that deals <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy.
After activation, gain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. For every additional 20 Energy consumed while holding, gain 1 more <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tongue Flick</color>.
A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 4th hit lands, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy grants an additional 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>.
en.Cissia_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:

en.Cissia_Skill_QTE_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Cissia_Skill_Rush_Desc:

en.Cissia_Skill_Special_01_Desc:

When gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>, every 1 excess point of <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> once.

en.EquipmentSuit_32200_4_des: Upon hitting a <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate is increased by 28% for 8s.

en.EquipmentSuit_32400_4_des: As long as an enemy in combat is <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color>, the equipper's ATK is increased by 28%.

en.EquipmentSuit_32900_2_des: The DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershocks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> is increased by 15%.

en.Evelyn_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> DMG increases by 30%. When Evelyn's CRIT Rate is at or over 80%, the DMG multiplier for her <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Timbre</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Lunalux Garrote - Shadow</color> increases to 125% of the original value.
en.Evelyn_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Evelyn slashes with <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color>, then triggers an explosion ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Branch_01_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is at 50% or higher, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a slashing attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Branch_02_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> is 50% or higher, after using <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color>, continue to hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Consume 50% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to perform a follow-up attack, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to slash surrounding enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>;
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Enhance_Desc:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> or consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Decibels</color> to perform an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
Once Evelyn has 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color>, her next use of <color=#FFFFFF>Garrote</color> will consume all <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_ExQTE_02_Desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, and when Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
Upon activating this skill, Evelyn removes her jacket and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, which lasts for the entire battle. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dance of Awakened Fire</color> state, when Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, she will retain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>. When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target, entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> and with enough Energy, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After pulling in surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form
en.Evelyn_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Evelyn slashes in front with multiple <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrotes</color> and detonates an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> to enemies in the area.
When the attack hits an enemy, Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enters <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_RopeSpecial_Desc:
Before entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to pull the enemy and charge forward with a kick, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
When the attack hits the enemy, Evelyn will use <color=#FFFFFF>Lunalux Garrote</color> to bind the primary target and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Evelyn_Skill_Special_Desc:
After entering <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Centered on the target affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, tether surrounding enemies and detonate an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color> will end after detonation.
Dodge enemy attacks upon activating the skill, and if a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered, gain an additional 25% <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>.
After tethering surrounding enemies, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to cancel detonation and immediately follow up with the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack's</color> 3rd hit.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

en.Harumasa_Skill_AimAttack_Desc:
After the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, or a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Immediately shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to aim at a target and release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
en.Harumasa_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExQTE_Upgrade_Desc:
Activates ALT automatically after Ultimate: Zanshin:
Unleashes a wide-area piercing attack against enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. This is considered Ultimate DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> after using the 4th/5th attack of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Braced Bow</color> to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field, firing <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the target, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the target's <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> stacks are close to the maximum, fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Title: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run - Patrol
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Desc:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Title: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
en.Harumasa_Skill_FinishingSlash_Upgrade_De:
While there are <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, switching <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.

While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Rush forward to the closest <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Hitting a Stunned enemy triggers Chasing Thunder, dealing 1 instance of additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>. With less than 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> will be removed from the enemy. Before <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> is removed, repeatedly press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to repeatedly use <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>. While no <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color> enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Awakened</color> state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Feather</color> to quickly follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color>.
Enemy attacks can be blocked during the 1st hit of the skill. The pursuit effect of the second and third hits is increased.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
en.Harumasa_Skill_MoveAttack_Desc:
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
After activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color> and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
en.Harumasa_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Harumasa_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Harumasa_Skill_TriggerAttack_Desc:
When the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. If there are no <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color>. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present at a time. If there are any <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quivers</color> will activate and fire <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> at the enemies hit by <color=#FFFFFF>Falling Feather</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will apply <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color>, they will be <color=#FFFFFF>X-Marked</color>.
en.Harumasa_UniqueSkill_01_Desc: The CRIT Rate of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10.6%</color>, and when Harumasa's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color>, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Gleaming Edge</color> increases the CRIT DMG of <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash</color> by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>.

en.HugoVlad_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character or shares the same attribute:
<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color>'s DMG increases by 15%, with a further increase of 35% against normal enemies. When <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the DMG dealt by the skill increases by 40%. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment</color> generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a shot. During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to four attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The fourth attack is a shot. During this attack, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the fourth attack, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
After the 4th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet</color>, the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Phantasm - Slash</color>, or the shot of <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Elegy</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Throw the scythe forward to perform a slash, followed by a shot, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
During the shot, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to charge and perform a charged shot.
During this skill, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
en.HugoVlad_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launch a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.HugoVlad_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.HugoVlad_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Trick of Fate</color> hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Dark Abyss Reverb</color> state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>/<color=#2BAD00>75</color>.

en.JaneDoe_Enhance_Desc:
When Jane triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Upon reaching the maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>, Jane enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> regenerates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>. Jane exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state when all of her <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> is consumed.
en.JaneDoe_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is increased by 20%. When the enemy is already suffering from an Attribute Anomaly, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color> towards the target is increased by an additional 15%.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_BeHitAid_Enhance_Desc:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
en.JaneDoe_Skill_Branch_Upgrade_Desc:

When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.

en.Lighter_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Lighter automatically gains <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>, up to a maximum of 100. When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.

When <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. Once <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> puts Lighter in the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>. With every 10 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by <color=#2BAD00>1.5%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, and lasting 6s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> over time. If his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> runs out, Lighter will leave the <color=#FFFFFF>Morale Burst</color> state, keeping any unspent <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color>.

en.Lucia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
This Ultimate is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> lasts 8s. While inside <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color>, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.01+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*0.0005,100,2}%</color> of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. If she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state when activating this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, she will gain 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> and re-enter <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.
en.Lucia_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:

This EX Special Attack is a <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
When Lucia uses any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, all squad members gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:5+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.2,1,1}</color> Sheer Force. The <color=#FFFFFF>Darkbreaker</color> state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:612+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*24,1,2}</color>, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.34+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.03,100,2}%</color> of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state and under the effect of <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
If not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, Lucia gains 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Dream Points</color> upon using this <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

en.Lycaon_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Lycaon charges his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to completion, the attack deals <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> increased Daze.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG RES</color> decreases by 25% for 30s.
en.Lycaon_UniqueSkill_01_Upgrade_Desc:
When Lycaon completes charging during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, or activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, the Daze inflicted by the skill increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> has available activations, hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Lycaon enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance is gained. Up to 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation can be stored.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends, Lycaon automatically activates <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>6%</color>.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Lycaon will end the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state early.
When Lycaon manually uses <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state also ends early, but <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> will not be automatically triggered.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, Lycaon will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When the active character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. After performing a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> duration does not decrease.
