When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> hits an enemy, the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> is reduced by 25%, and it increases the DMG to the target from other attributes by <color=#FFFFFF>30%</color> for 30s.
Upon entering the battlefield, Lycaon gains one <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> has available activations, hitting an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. During this skill, when other squad members enter via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Lycaon enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state for 8s.
When an elite or boss enemy becomes Stunned, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation chance is gained. Up to 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> activation can be stored.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends, Lycaon automatically activates <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>. If the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state ends early, for every 1s of remaining duration, the Daze dealt by the next <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>6%</color>.
When the currently active character stops attacking or uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Lycaon will end the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state early.
When Lycaon manually uses <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state also ends early, but <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Vengeful Counterattack - Glacial Waltz</color> will not be automatically triggered.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, Lycaon will activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> based on the skills used by the currently active character.
When the currently active character uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform the 1st through 3rd hits of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
When the active character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, Lycaon will simultaneously perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>. After performing a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state, Lycaon can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
While the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> state is active, when Lycaon is not the currently active Agent, his attacks only deal DMG and Daze. While Lycaon is the currently active character, the <color=#FFFFFF>Encircle Prey</color> duration does not decrease.

en.NangongYu_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same Faction:
Any squad member's attack against a Stunned enemy has 30% increased Anomaly Buildup. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> against a Stunned enemy have an additional 30% increased Anomaly Buildup.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, up to a maximum of 2 stacks, lasting 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration. With <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, when a heavy attack from Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Emergency Save</color> hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> is consumed to trigger the special <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> against all enemies who meet the conditions. This deals DMG equal to 25% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, and triggers the previous squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly. If the skill fails to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will not be consumed. When Nangong Yu has <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color>, the next time she switches to the field, she will immediately perform the first charged hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, which will always trigger precise charging.
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, Nangong Yu's next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> will not consume Energy. This effect lasts 15s and can trigger once every 15s.
When Nangong Yu and Aria are in the same squad, if Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> heavy attack hits an enemy that is both Stunned and affected by an Attribute Anomaly, and Nangong Yu fully participates in the attack, 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Dance Prowess</color> will also be consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color> on all enemies who meet the conditions.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Meteor Shower</color> hits an enemy, the enemy suffers <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color>. Under this effect, Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% and when an enemy becomes Stunned, their Stun duration increases by 3s. Before recovering from Stun, <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> can only trigger once on the same target. The increased Stun duration cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> recovers from Stun, the <color=#FFFFFF>Misstep</color> effect ends.
en.NangongYu_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks on the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a charged attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Release the button at the right moment to trigger precise charging, increasing the Daze dealt by the skill by 20%.
Nangong Yu can perform up to three hits. The second and third hits each must consume 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>.
After using a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, if enough <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> are available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to skip the first hit and directly perform the second and third hits, which always trigger precise charging.
When Nangong Yu is the active character, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> do not interrupt the combo count of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>.
While charging the first hit, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken decreases by 60%.
While charging the second and third hits, the character is Invulnerable.
During the dash phase of the first hit, enemy attacks can be Blocked. On a successful Block, the attack is treated as a precise charging attack.
Character is invulnerable during all attacks.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launch multiple attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. If Nangong Yu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> again, the current <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise</color> will first deactivate.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Title: EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love
en.NangongYu_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
en.NangongYu_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Special_01_Desc:

Delivers a morning star attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
en.NangongYu_Skill_Special_01_Title: Special Attack: The Weight of Love
en.NangongYu_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>60</color>.
When Nangong Yu's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, each point of initial Anomaly Mastery above that increases her Impact by 1.
When an enemy is Stunned, each time any character triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG, <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG, or inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on the enemy, the enemy gains 1 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
A single enemy can have up to 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> reaches the maximum stacks and the enemy is afflicted with an <color=#FE437E>Ether</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind</color> Anomaly, or if the enemy has <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> and recovers from being Stunned, all <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> stacks will be cleared.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> is cleared, if the enemy is suffering an aforementioned Attribute Anomaly, Nangong Yu triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG on the target, dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>720%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>360%</color>/<color=#FF5521>900%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>63%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>90%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>36%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> on the enemy increases this <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG ratio by an additional 25%. During the same Stun period, once <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> has been cleared, the enemy cannot gain <color=#FFFFFF>Vibrato</color> again.
When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>17%</color>, and her Daze dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>11%</color>, and the whole squad's DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>13%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in combat, Nangong Yu restores 3.8 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>/s. When any squad member inflicts an Attribute Anomaly on an enemy, Nangong Yu restores an additional 12 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>. This effect can trigger once every 6s.
Nangong Yu can have up to 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color>, and starts with 30 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeats</color> upon entering the battlefield.

en.Norano_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes of an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.
en.Norano_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_AssaultAid_Title: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
en.Norano_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Counter_Title: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
en.Norano_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:

Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
During each slash, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
While in the Molten Edge state, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will be consumed.
en.Norano_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Title: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
en.Norano_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:

Gain 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_ParryAid_Title: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
en.Norano_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Norano_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color>. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Norano_Skill_Special_02_Title: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
en.Norano_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Norano_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, he accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color>, Manato enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato consumes 3.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> per second. When <color=#FFFFFF>Blazing Heart</color> is fully depleted, he exits <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color>.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> are enhanced, and he can use <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall</color>.
When consuming HP during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash</color> or during the consecutive slashes from an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.

en.ProfessionDes_BreakStun: Agents with the Stun specialty possess powerful control abilities, excelling at building up Daze to cause enemies to be Stunned, thus creating opportunities for the squad to deal damage.
en.ProfessionDes_Defence: Agents with the Defense specialty have strong survivability, excelling at tanking attacks to counterattack, seizing the upper hand for their side in the heat of battle.
en.ProfessionDes_Destroy: Agents with the Rupture specialty possess great offense and survival capabilities, excelling at using Sheer DMG that ignores enemy defenses to deal massive damage.
en.ProfessionDes_ElementAbnormal: Agents with the Anomaly specialty are exceptional with applying debuffs, excelling at accumulating Anomaly Buildup to weaken enemies and deal damage by triggering Attribute Anomalies.
en.ProfessionDes_PowerfulAttack: Agents with the Attack specialty possess formidable damage output capabilities, excelling at rapidly racking up damage directly through attacks to defeat enemies and bring the combat to a swift end.
en.ProfessionDes_Support: Agents with the Support specialty are able to aid and enhance other Agents in battle, excelling at buffing friendly units to improve the combat effectiveness of the whole squad.
en.Promeia_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Promeia's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by 30% for 30s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When any squad member applies the <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> effect to an enemy, its duration is increased by 3s.
When Promeia's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> on a target with <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color>, it ignores 40% of the target's DEF. <color=#FFFFFF>Presumption of Guilt</color> lasts 30s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
en.Promeia_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Promeia leaps into the air and attacks, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
en.Promeia_Skill_Buff_Desc:
When using certain skills, Promeia throws her cape to continuously slice enemies, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> upon hit.
While the cape remains out, Promeia can walk slowly.
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> during this period to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
If attacked during this period, Promeia triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> automatically. The dodge can trigger once every 20s.
en.Promeia_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks against the target, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches a series of forward attacks, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 250% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Performs a flying blade attack, throwing her cape beside the enemy and entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If attacked by an enemy shortly after using the move, automatically chains into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>.
Upon use, Promeia gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
Triggers automatically when hit shortly upon activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Glacial Death</color>:
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> state briefly and swiftly circles behind the enemy.
After triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, and with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to consume 40 Energy and activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, gaining the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_03_Desc:
While under the <color=#FFFFFF>Absolute Order</color> effect, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state to activate:
Leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a descending attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_04_Desc:
After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly launches a flurry of attacks, then leaps toward the enemy, retrieving the cape while performing a more powerful downward attack that deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing, if Promeia possesses <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_06_Desc:
With enough <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> and after performing the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Descending Frost</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special> after landing to activate:
Quickly leaps back while unleashing a more powerful finishing move, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Hitting enemies does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
After using this skill, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or <IconMap:Icon_Special>, or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_ExSpecial_06_Title: EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment
en.Promeia_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to five attacks against enemies ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After landing the fifth hit's downward attack, and with sufficient <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, keep holding <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain into <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>.
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bound Absolution</color> state after throwing the cape during the fourth hit.
en.Promeia_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws flying blades and hangs upside down above the enemy, unleashing a flurry of attacks and ending with a finishing move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing 100% Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sweeping Edge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Promeia_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick attack forward, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.Promeia_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a flying blade attack, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.Promeia_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
If Promeia's initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 150, each additional point increases her Anomaly Proficiency by 1.5 and increases the whole squad's <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG by 0.35%.
Promeia gains a set amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> when her attacks hit enemies. When squad members trigger <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, when the enemy is inflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, or when Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she gains an additional 5/5/5/10 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When a squad member triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Promeia gains an additional 15 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> reaches at least 50, 50 <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> is consumed and converted into 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, up to a maximum of 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
Upon entering the battlefield, Promeia gains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>.
When the finishing move of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, dealing <color=#2BAD00>330%</color> Attribute Anomaly DMG of the corresponding attribute. The skill consumes 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> upon activation.
When Promeia triggers and hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, she gains an additional 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color> grants <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>. With <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color>, after using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Hanging Judgment</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Glaciating Impalement</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> and immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Oath</color> can be held.

en.Seed_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_BeHitAid_Title: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
en.Seed_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Final_Desc:

Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Final_Title: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
en.Seed_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> for the first two hits and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Robot_01_Desc:
After the 4th hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, hold or press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> by holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>. This effect expires when <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> once.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_Normal_Robot_02_Desc:
Seed has <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
<color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!</color>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> and unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form</color>, then automatically consume 60 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> to follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form</color>.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Does not accumulate <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Seed_Skill_QTE_Title: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
en.Seed_Skill_Rush_Desc:

en.Seed_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
The <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Seed gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status, increasing Seed's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>. When Seed unleashes an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status, increasing the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>'s ATK by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> and CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> are both active, Seed and the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> simultaneously gain <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, increasing DMG dealt by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color>, Seed immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status, while the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> immediately gains <color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> status and <color=#FFFFFF>Besiege</color> status.
<color=#FFFFFF>Direct Strike</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Onslaught</color> status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the <color=#FFFFFF>Vanguard</color> consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color>.

en.Sigrid_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Basic Attack]</color> 4th hit, <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Ultimate]</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>[Dodge Counter]</color> are considered <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>;
When Sigrid hits an enemy with any <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>, if not currently in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> and the <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> that landed the hit enters <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status, while gaining 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> activation opportunity, up to a maximum of 1;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, when Sigrid uses any <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color> that is not in <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status, she can refresh <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> and gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> activation opportunity, up to a maximum of 1; When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> is refreshed, the <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status transfers to the newly triggered <color=#FFFFFF>[Draw Stance]</color>;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> hits an enemy, <color=#FFFFFF>[Inactive]</color> status is removed and the next <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> advances by 1 stage, up to a maximum of 3 stages; After triggering the 3rd stage <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage is immediately reset to stage 1 and <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> ends;
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> decreases as <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage increases: at stages 1/2/3, the duration is <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>7</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>6</color>s respectively;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> ends, <color=#FFFFFF>[Holster Stance]</color> stage decreases by 1, down to a minimum of stage 1;
When <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color> is activated or refreshed, Sigrid's CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>33%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s; repeated triggers can extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum duration of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s;
While in <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Gunform]</color>, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> is reduced.

A quick dash dodge.

en.Trigger_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.
en.Trigger_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color>. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> without consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering <color=#FFFFFF>Coordinated Support</color> extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

While encircling the enemy, rapidly fire two shots at the enemy, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The squad can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color> once every 3s.
en.Trigger_Skill_Normal_ChainAttack_Desc_02:
When Trigger has <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, use another active character in the squad to hit an enemy with a heavy attack from an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to activate:
While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> attack.
The same skill type can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus</color> will immediately activate instead if triggered.
en.Trigger_Skill_Normal_ChargeAttack_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Trigger enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> and fires forward continuously, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>, up to a maximum of 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color>.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character in the squad. A <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

en.Unagi_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, or shares the same Faction:
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> DMG increases by 60%. When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Shimotsuki</color> during the next <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> will ignore 30% of the target's <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color>.
en.Unagi_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Charges and slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_ChargeAttack_Desc:
With at least 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Hoshimi Miyabi sheaths her blade, enters <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color> and starts to charge up. Every level of charge will consume 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, up to a maximum of three levels of charge.
When releasing <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, or when <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> is completely depleted, Hoshimi Miyabi will draw her blade and unleash a powerful slash ahead based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>. She then exits <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Character is invulnerable during <color=#FFFFFF>Shimotsuki Stance</color>.
Hoshimi Miyabi can have up to 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
en.Unagi_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
While dodging, repeatedly press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A dash dodge that covers a lot of ground.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Unleashes powerful slashes at enemies ahead in a large area then pauses, before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 3 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and increase <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by 30% for 12s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Rush forward, unleashing powerful slashes against enemies along the way, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again to activate:
Consume extra Energy and unleash a powerful follow-up attack against enemies in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes ahead, the first two deal <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and the last three deal <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Block enemy attacks during the 5th hit of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.
en.Unagi_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Unagi_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
en.Unagi_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Quickly draws her blade and slashes ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Unagi_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Hoshimi Miyabi deals <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color>, she applies <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to the target, lasting 30s. When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>750%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>14%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.
Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

When accumulating <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color> against targets with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, increases <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by 100% of Hoshimi Miyabi's CRIT Rate, up to a maximum increase of 80%. As Hoshimi Miyabi accumulates <color=#98EFF0>Frost Anomaly Buildup</color>, it has its own independent Attribute Anomaly Buildup gauge and triggers <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, and <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> that can react with other Attribute Anomalies, including <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.
When Hoshimi Miyabi applies <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> to enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color>, it will consume the <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>1,375%</color> of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK and causing the target to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state. All units accumulate <color=#2BAD00>19%</color> more Anomaly Buildup against enemies under the <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state, but Hoshimi Miyabi cannot reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to these enemies. The <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> state ends when <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> expires. While this state remains active, triggering another Attribute Anomaly will overwrite <color=#98EFF0>Frostbite</color> and remove <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color>.
Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi obtains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same attribute:

en.Vivian_Skill_Branch_Air_Desc:

en.XiaoZhao_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When Zhao is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, if <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a falling slash in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Branch_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0.12+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*0.01,100,2}%</color> of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out when the skill activates, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> and a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks in front, followed by a falling slash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gains 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Launches multiple forward slashes, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:1+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.06,1,2}%</color> of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra</color> can trigger at most once every 30s.
Upon activating this skill, gain 20 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>, and the following four <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple slashes in front, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
After using this skill, gains 5 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. If <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill while in any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_SpecialAid_Desc:
When Zhao has maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>, and is in combat, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
Upon activating this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, Zhao automatically follows up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Final Verdict</color> and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.XiaoZhao_Skill_Special_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Upon activating this skill, consumes 5% of current HP to grant all squad members HP regeneration equal to <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:1+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*0.06,1,2}%</color> of Zhao's Max HP per second for 5s. The HP-consuming effects of <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Shatterfrost Surge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frostflow Tundra</color> can trigger at most once every 30s.
en.XiaoZhao_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining <color=#2BAD00>0.8%</color> CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>.
When Zhao activates her <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> are consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> ends the existing instance before applying a new <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>.
When Zhao activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, all squad members' ATK increase by <color=#2BAD00>100</color> for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
en.XiaoZhao_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:

Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color> is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 <color=#FFFFFF>Frostbite Points</color>. This can be triggered once every 3s.

en.Yidhari_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>Stun</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Support</color> character:
When Yidhari's HP falls below 50%, CRIT DMG increases by 30% and DMG taken is reduced by 25%.
While Yidhari is within <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, she gains the following additional effect:
After the level 3 charged attack of Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, an icy tentacle is summoned to attack, dealing extra damage. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
The above skill is considered an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the DMG multiplier increases based on the EX Special Attack's level.
en.Yidhari_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Execute an ice shard hammer attack against enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Branch_01_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When <IconMap:Icon_Normal> is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Strike</color>. The DMG of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Strike</color> triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to chain early into the finishing smash.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Branch_02_Desc:
While charging or spinning during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color>, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> makes Yidhari unleash a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit</color> that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, she can use <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret</color> once.
en.Yidhari_Skill_ExQTE_Title: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
en.Yidhari_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:
When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Dash forward with an upward attack, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP.
If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
After using this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately unleash the finishing slam of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> based on the current charge level.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.
en.Yidhari_Skill_ParryAid_Desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
If inside <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Space_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, the final hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frost Coil</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath</color> will consume 3,000 Decibels to activate an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>. While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5% for 30s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 300s.
While Yidhari is within <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, the charge speed of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> increases, and HP is consumed faster during charging.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> or <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady_Rp> while charging or spinning during <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color>, or press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> while holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>.
When the skill's attack collides with an enemy's attack, it triggers Surging Cold.
If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit.
Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum.
During this skill, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> based on the current charge level.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
en.Yidhari_Skill_Special_02_Title: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit

en.Yuzuha_Skill_Evade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to activate:

en.Yuzuha_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color> state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:7+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*1.5,1,2}</color> Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Yuzuha_Skill_ExQTE_Title: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
en.Yuzuha_Skill_ExSpecial_02_Desc:

en.Yuzuha_Skill_Normal_Branch_Desc:

Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.
en.Yuzuha_Skill_Normal_Chain_Desc:
When Yuzuha has <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>. en.Yuzuha_Skill_Normal_Desc:

en.Yuzuha_Skill_Normal_Sugar_Desc:

Activating this skill is considered as activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
en.Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
en.Zhenzhen_UniqueSkill_02_Desc:
When not in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color>. Whenever <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> is gained by any means, each 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> stacks are consumed to grant the same number of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Unity</color>, increasing CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>17.5%</color> and DMG by <color=#2BAD00>12.5%</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Chasing Storms</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness</color> is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state and activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> has the same duration as <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color>. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> dealt by her skills becomes <color=#F0D12B>Honed Edge DMG</color>.
While <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> is active, when an enemy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color>, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Verdict</color> ends.
